title: Rooted Smith

steps.prompt: A sturdy cheerful village blacksmith woman with strong arms, a thick leather apron, rolled sleeves, short tied-back hair, soot on one cheek, hammer hanging from the belt, earthy cream and tan clothes with a leaf-green scarf. Full-body character design, one person standing in a relaxed A-pose facing the viewer, whole body in frame from head to feet, plain flat white background, even lighting, anime proportions about seven heads tall, slightly large hands. High-end anime fantasy RPG key visual, stylised 3D look with painterly textures, soft cel shading with warm bounce light and cool rim light, detailed ornate equipment with engraved metal, layered cloth and leather, realistic proportions, expressive anime faces, lush bright colours with luminous highlights, original design, no photorealism, no text, no watermark, no logo.

steps.version: trellis_2_bf16 with shape and texture VAEs and dino_v3_vit_l (Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2), BiRefNet background removal inside the workflow, ComfyUI 0.39.0 built-in nodes
